name: Per-scene fine-tuning of MVSNeRF
definition: A post-processing step where the predicted neural encoding volume and an MLP decoder are optimized per scene to achieve high-quality fine-tuning results, starting from the generalizable initial reconstruction.
summary: Per-scene fine-tuning of MVSNeRF is a post-processing optimization that refines the neural encoding volume and MLP decoder to eliminate residual errors and artifacts, converging to high-quality renderings in approximately 15 minutes.
